notes.note: Checked this page for claims about what fix round 3 changes in the composer's first send: the Project approval read now happens after the send enters its in-flight state, is bounded by its own timer, and a stale send (closed chat, superseded, Station or account switched) stops unsent with its text restored. The durable outbox row is still written before the request goes out. This page makes no claim those change, so it remains accurate.
